title: ledger issue record (issue.v1)
description: One issue record per file at ledger/issues/<id>.json; the filename MUST equal the record id. Drafts (ledger/drafts/<member>/<slug>.json) use this same schema minus `id` — ids are minted only on the integration branch (SPEC.md R29). This file is documentation and agent reference; the cs-ledger binary enforces these rules natively, and the test suite pins the two to the same verdicts.

id.description: Stable forever; never renumbered or reused. Prefix comes from ledger.json idPrefix.

status.description: Lifecycle: open -> in-progress -> closed | wont-fix | moved-to-roadmap. Roadmap-style directions are feature-idea records with status open.

resolved.description: Date the record reached a terminal status. Required non-null for closed/wont-fix/moved-to-roadmap; must be null otherwise.

stint.description: Which stint selected it — the slug-named scoped burst of work (an orchestrated run like 'rev-5', a branch, a working session). Required non-null when status is in-progress; null is valid on closed rows fixed host-direct.

integrated.description: Integration-branch commit sha(s), where the workflow distinguishes them.

verified.description: How the closure was verified (markdown). Required non-empty when closed.

resolution.description: Why the record ended without a fix (markdown). Required non-empty for wont-fix / moved-to-roadmap.

details.description: The narrative writeup (markdown). Original observation only — later updates go to notes.

notes.description: Append-only dated updates; dates must be non-decreasing.

links.description: Stated relationships to other issues. An unresolvable link is a warning, not a failure (partial migration is a normal state).

then.$comment: Additionally: evidence.commits non-empty OR links non-empty (delegation closure, e.g. an umbrella row closed via child issues). Expressed in `cs-ledger check`; JSON Schema alone cannot state the cross-field disjunction cleanly.
